changelog:
SHANEX Print Manager Pro v5.0.12

- Fix repeated WhatsApp duplicate warnings: notify after durable customer import and deduplicate replayed deliveries.
- Preserve hydrated session baselines and deferred file overlays, existing ownership, print settings and inbox identities.
- Keep standalone recovery independent of stale LAN outbox entries; local WhatsApp printing bypasses the remote SWIP operation queue.
- Add visible Select, Options, Cancel and Delete-from-queue actions and right-click menus to job cards.
- Default dashboard date filters to Today and keep long print-setting badges compact.
- Retain protected website order validation and active-print removal safeguards.

Installer is unsigned. Live WhatsApp/restart, UNC storage, legacy-upgrade and physical-output acceptance remain pending. Rescan/profile-script errors and unexplained window closures are not claimed fixed.
